use_case_name: Transfer a Winning Order to Another Customer

claims.content: To give JTVauctions.com a competitive advantage over Bidz.com, Overstock Auctions, uBid.com, and other similar sites by improving the customer experience through greater relationship building and value-creation for the customer and to improve our inventory turns by selling churned product much faster, reducing the need to re-schedule cancelled orders.

goal.raw_text: To give JTVauctions.com a competitive advantage over Bidz.com, Overstock Auctions, uBid.com, and other similar sites by improving the customer experience through greater relationship building and value-creation for the customer and to improve our inventory turns by selling churned product much faster, reducing the need to re-schedule cancelled orders.

claims.content: Customer
When orders are cancelled.
When orders are cancelled, an automated email is triggered which goes to the second-place finisher offering to sell the item at their last bid price.
The user is given three days from the time the email is sent to accept the offer.
The email recipient clicks on an acceptance button ("I accept, pay with my On File credit card" or "Pay with PayPal or Amazon Payments").
If the Credit Card Option is selected, the action triggers an automated process to generate an order and ship the item.
If the PayPal or Amazon Payments Option is selected, clicking the button generates the order and loads the Sign-In page.
After signing in, the user is taken to the Returning Winners Payments Page where they can pay for the order.
The email will not be sent if the 2nd-place finisher’s bid is below the item’s unit cost.
If the customer selects the “Decline Option” (“No Thanks” button), the item will be released from a hold status back into auction available inventory.
If the customer does not respond to the 2nd-Chance email within 72 hours after the email is sent, the item will be returned to auction available inventory and rescheduled for a future auction.
An order is generated.
The item is shipped.
No further action by the customer will be needed.
